entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Fear, dread, panic, terror, horror, turmoil; Thoughts, instinct; Heart, chest, pulse, blood; Head, brain, temples, forehead; Breath, throat, windpipe, cheeks, tongue, bile; Stomach, gut, cramps; Skin, hair, shivers, tingle, prickle
entries.zh: 害怕、惧怕、惊慌、恐惧、惊骇、慌乱；思绪、本能；心脏、胸口、脉搏、血液；头、脑、太阳穴、额头；呼吸、喉咙、气管、脸颊、舌头、胆汁；胃、肠腹、痉挛；皮肤、毛发、寒战、麻感、刺痛。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Numb, sick, nervous, uneasy; Dry, tight, thick, heavy; Long, deep, short, shallow; Unsteady, shuddering, rasping; Quick, fast, painful; Cold, tingling; Hot, sweaty
entries.zh: 麻木、恶心、紧张、不安；干、紧、厚、沉；长、深、短、浅；不稳、颤抖、粗重；快、迅速、痛苦；冷、发麻；热、出汗。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Felt, thought, urged, warned, paralysed; Rose, grew, swept, surged, seized; Bubbled, gripped, clutched, choked, strangled; Breathed, blew, hissed, sucked, gulped, gasped, tasted; Beat, leapt, raced, banged, throbbed, pounded, hammered, quickened; Crept, crawled, prickled, scuttled; Ran, tore, pumped, drenched; Dropped, fluttered, squeezed, tightened, gripped, stabbed
entries.zh: 感觉、想、催促、警告、使僵住；升起、增强、席卷、涌起、抓住；冒泡、紧抓、攫住、噎住、扼住；呼吸、呼气、嘶气、吸、吞气、喘、尝到；跳、猛跳、加速、撞击、搏动、猛跳、猛敲、加快；爬、蠕动、刺痛、急窜；流、撕裂、泵送、浸透；下沉、扑动、挤压、收紧、攥住、刺痛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Every nerve in his body warned him not to go any further.
entries.zh: 全身每根神经都在警告他不要再往前走。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: All his instincts screamed at him to slip away before he was spotted.
entries.zh: 他的本能拼命催促他，在被发现之前悄悄溜走。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was sick with fear, but the thought of the consequences urged him on.
entries.zh: 他吓得胃里难受，但想到后果，还是逼着自己往前走。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her throat was dry, her tongue thick and heavy in her mouth.
entries.zh: 她喉咙干涩，嘴里的舌头又厚又沉。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Fear choked him with its murderous hands. It gripped at his throat and strangled his breath into short, shallow gasps.
entries.zh: 恐惧用杀人的双手扼住他，掐紧喉咙，使他的呼吸变成短浅的喘息。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was struck dead with terror. Her heart was beating painfully fast and banging against her ribs.
entries.zh: 她吓得僵住，心脏快得生疼，一下下撞着肋骨。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her heart missed a beat, squeezed like a vice by the shock.
entries.zh: 惊吓像虎钳般夹住她的心，使心跳漏了一拍。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As the blood pounded in her temples, her brain quickened and all her senses were alert.
entries.zh: 血液在太阳穴里突突跳动，她的大脑迅速运转，所有感官都警觉起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Blowing out her cheeks, she drew a long, shuddering breath and tried to dampen the sense of impending doom.
entries.zh: 她鼓着脸呼气，又长长地颤抖着吸了一口，努力压住大祸临头的感觉。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He felt uneasy. The hairs on the back of his neck prickled with dread and he was drenched in sweat.
entries.zh: 他心里不安，后颈汗毛因恐惧竖起，全身被汗浸透。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Fear settled on her like a dark fog, bringing a chill that crept over her and that no amount of heat could drive away.
entries.zh: 恐惧像浓黑的雾笼罩她，寒意爬遍全身，再多热量也驱不散。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The fear was like an electric shock, pumping shivering waves tearing through his body and making his hair stand on end.
entries.zh: 恐惧像电击，带着一阵阵寒战撕过他的身体，使毛发直竖。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He doubled over with cramps. It was as if a lead ball had been dropped in his stomach and was blocking his gut.
entries.zh: 他痉挛得弯下腰，仿佛胃里落下一个铅球，堵住了肠腹。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her stomach was gripped with anxiety, like a volcano erupting inside her.
entries.zh: 焦虑紧攥着她的胃，仿佛一座火山正在体内喷发。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Something was making her feel very uneasy. It was gnawing at her stomach and fluttering as if she had swallowed a butterfly.
entries.zh: 某种东西让她十分不安，啃噬着她的胃，又扑腾不止，仿佛吞下一只蝴蝶。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Worry, anxiety, terror, horror; Look, expression, glance, gaze, stare; Mouth, teeth, jaw
entries.zh: 担忧、焦虑、恐惧、惊骇；神情、表情、瞥视、凝视、盯视；嘴、牙齿、下颌。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Alert, sharp, urgent; Edgy, nervous, troubled, pinched; Startled, horrified, haggard, contorted; Pale, bloodless, ashen, expressionless
entries.zh: 警觉、敏锐、急迫；紧张不安、紧张、忧虑、紧缩；受惊、惊恐、憔悴、扭曲；苍白、无血色、灰白、无表情。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Wore, showed, drained; Froze, dropped, trembled; Bared, clenched, chattered, gnashed
entries.zh: 带着、显示、褪去；僵住、落下、颤抖；露出、咬紧、打战、磨牙。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her eyes swept over the scene in front of her and her face froze in horror.
entries.zh: 她的目光扫过眼前景象，脸因惊骇而僵住。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was rooted to the spot, hands trembling and her face ashen and drenched in sweat.
entries.zh: 她双脚像生根般定在原地，双手发抖，脸色灰白，满是冷汗。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her face was expressionless, but inwardly she was fighting to remain calm.
entries.zh: 她面无表情，内心却在拼命保持镇静。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The smile dropped from her face like a theatrical mask, to be replaced by a look of sheer terror.
entries.zh: 笑容像戏剧面具一样从她脸上掉下，取而代之的是极度恐惧。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As she listened to the news, a troubled expression settled on her face.
entries.zh: 听着消息，她脸上渐渐浮现忧虑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her face was drawn and anxious, as she paced backwards and forwards across the room.
entries.zh: 她在房间里来回踱步，脸上焦虑憔悴。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her mouth was twisted in a scream that never came.
entries.zh: 她的嘴扭成了尖叫的形状，却始终没发出声音。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The smile suddenly fell from her face and her jaw dropped open.
entries.zh: 笑容突然从她脸上消失，她惊得张开了嘴。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She bit her lip to stop her teeth chattering like castanets.
entries.zh: 她咬住嘴唇，不让牙齿像响板般打战。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Clasping her hands in her lap, she moved her lips silently in prayer.
entries.zh: 她把双手握在膝上，嘴唇无声地动着，默默祈祷。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He turned his head sharply, raised an eyebrow and bared his teeth in an edgy grin.
entries.zh: 他猛地转头，挑起一边眉毛，紧张地龇牙笑了一下。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Gaze, stare, glance, trance, twitch, tic
entries.zh: 凝视、盯视、瞥视、恍惚、抽动、神经性痉挛。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Round, wide, staring, gaping, unblinking; Wary, wild, horror-struck
entries.zh: 圆睁、睁大、直盯、大张、一眨不眨；警惕、狂乱、惊恐。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Blinked, stared, strained; Swept, darted, snapped, flicked, flickered
entries.zh: 眨眼、盯、用力看；扫视、急转、猛然睁开、掠过、闪动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His eyes snapped open in panic and he froze to the spot.
entries.zh: 他惊慌地猛睁双眼，整个人僵在原地。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He shifted uncomfortably and flicked his eyes from one to the other.
entries.zh: 他不自在地挪动身体，目光从一个人扫向另一个人。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was horror-struck. She stared unblinking, as if in a trance, and frozen to the spot.
entries.zh: 她吓坏了，一眨不眨地盯着，仿佛失神般僵在原地。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His wide eyes strained to pierce the darkness, darting wildly from side to side.
entries.zh: 他瞪大眼努力看穿黑暗，目光慌乱地左右扫动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Drenched in sweat and heart pounding, Kitty kept her narrowed eyes fixed to the floor, unable to meet his cold, unblinking stare.
entries.zh: 基蒂汗流浃背、心跳如鼓，眯着眼盯住地板，不敢迎上他冷漠而不眨的目光。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Eyes round with terror, Robert let out a moan of despair and drew in a deep, shuddering breath.
entries.zh: 罗伯特吓得双眼圆睁，绝望地呻吟一声，深深吸了一口颤抖的气。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Tone, whisper, gasp, moan; Wail, yell, howl, scream, shriek
entries.zh: 语气、耳语、喘气、呻吟；哀号、大叫、嚎叫、尖叫、尖啸。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Silent, numb; Wild, urgent, savage, deathly; Shrill, high-pitched, harsh, strangled, piercing, quivering
entries.zh: 无声、麻木；狂乱、急迫、凶猛、死亡般；尖厉、高调、刺耳、哽塞、穿透、颤抖。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Spoke, whispered, mumbled, murmured, muttered; Gasped, panted, croaked, spluttered; Bleated, whined, pleaded, simpered, whimpered; Lowered, rushed, faltered, strained
entries.zh: 说、耳语、含糊说、低语、嘟囔；喘气、气喘、嘶哑说、急促结巴；咩咩般哀诉、哭诉、恳求、忸怩说、呜咽；压低、急说、迟疑、勉强发声。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.en: Tensely, anxiously, hurriedly, desperately, despairingly; Weakly, meekly
entries.zh: 紧张地、焦虑地、匆忙地、拼命地、绝望地；虚弱地、怯弱地。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His voice dropped to an urgent whisper.
entries.zh: 他的声音降成急切的耳语。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her high-pitched scream echoed through the house.
entries.zh: 她尖高的叫声回荡在整栋房子里。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her voice shook and her words came in gasps.
entries.zh: 她声音颤抖，话语随着喘息断断续续。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He let out a long, quivering sigh and shrank into silence.
entries.zh: 他长长地颤抖着叹了口气，退缩着沉默了。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She spoke in a rush, the words tumbling over each other in a jumbled stream, one rushing into the next.
entries.zh: 她说得很急，话语乱成一团，一个接一个地抢着涌出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She flung her head back and screamed – a savage, desperate yell like a wounded dog.
entries.zh: 她猛地仰头尖叫，像受伤的狗一样凶猛而绝望。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He started to shout. His voice, shrill and harsh like the shriek of a seagull, was full of violence and despair.
entries.zh: 他开始大叫，声音像海鸥尖啸一样尖厉刺耳，充满暴烈和绝望。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Pain, agony, surrender; Knees, hand, fist, palms, fingers, thumb, knuckles, nails; Chest, head, face, eyes, cheeks, mouth, lips; Skin, hair
entries.zh: 疼痛、剧痛、投降；膝、手、拳、掌、指、拇指、指关节、指甲；胸、头、脸、眼、颊、嘴、唇；皮肤、头发。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: White, pale, tense

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Bent, leant, curled, drew, hugged; Covered, buried; Squeezed, pinched, rubbed, pressed, gripped, clutched, crushed
entries.zh: 弯曲、倾身、蜷起、收起、抱紧；遮住、埋；挤、捏、揉、按、攥、抓、压紧。

entries.en: Curled hand into a fist

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gripped knuckles until they turned white

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Drew knees up and hugged them to his chest
entries.zh: 蜷起双膝，紧紧抱到胸前

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Buried his head in his hands

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pressed fingers into his eyes

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Rubbed eyes trying to get rid of the image
entries.zh: 揉眼，试图抹去脑中的画面

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Put his finger to his lips for her to be quiet
entries.zh: 把手指放在嘴唇上，示意她安静

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Covered his mouth and whispered through his fingers

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Rammed fingers into her ears to block out the screams
entries.zh: 把手指塞进耳朵以隔绝尖叫

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Ran hand through his hair, tugging it into wild tufts
entries.zh: 手穿过头发，把它扯成乱糟糟的发簇

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Clutched hand to her mouth

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Beckoned him forward with a tense jerk of her fingers
entries.zh: 紧张地勾动手指，示意他上前

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Raised her shaking hands in the air in an act of surrender
entries.zh: 举起颤抖的双手，表示投降

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He clutched his hand to his mouth to stop himself from screaming out.
entries.zh: 他死死捂住嘴，不让自己尖叫出声。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He shuddered and rubbed his eyes, trying to clear the image of what he had just seen.
entries.zh: 他打了个寒战，揉揉眼，试图抹去刚看到的画面。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He lowered his voice, leant forward in his chair and looked around cautiously before he spoke.
entries.zh: 他压低声音，在椅子上前倾，小心地环顾四周才开口。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He raised his shaking hands in the air, palms upwards, in an act of surrender.
entries.zh: 他举起颤抖的双手，掌心朝上，表示投降。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She screwed her eyes shut tight and rammed her fingers into her ears to block out the screams.
entries.zh: 她紧紧闭上眼，把手指塞进耳朵，想隔绝尖叫。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Statue, corpse; Legs, feet, knees, hands

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Still, frozen, rigid, corpse-like, motionless; Low, flat, snake-like; Slow, cautious, tentative; Fast, frantic, feverish, jerky; Upright, backwards, forwards
entries.zh: 静止、僵住、僵硬、尸体般、一动不动；低伏、平贴、蛇般；缓慢、小心、试探；快、疯狂、狂热、急促抽动；直立、向后、向前。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Froze, paralysed, stiffened; Stopped, halted, faltered; Skidded, slithered; Sat, crouched, squatted, huddled, flattened; Moved, walked, tiptoed, treaded, sneaked; Crept, crawled, groped, edged, clawed, squirmed, crabbed; Approached, advanced; Ran, sprinted, darted, bolted, hurtled; Crashed, dodged, leaped, jerked; Scrambled, scurried, scuttled; Struggled, fought, wrenched, staggered, stumbled, clambered, floundered, flailed
entries.zh: 僵住、瘫住、变僵；停止、停下、踉跄迟疑；滑停、蜿蜒滑动；坐、蹲伏、蹲、蜷缩、贴平；移动、行走、踮脚、踏步、偷走；爬行、匍匐、摸索、挪动、攀抓、扭动、横挪；靠近、前进；跑、冲刺、急窜、逃窜、猛冲；撞、闪躲、跳、猛动；攀爬、疾跑、急窜；挣扎、奋力、扭脱、踉跄、绊倒、爬上、慌乱挣扎、乱挥。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.en: Slowly, lightly, quickly, swiftly; Shakily, cautiously; Wildly, blindly, helplessly, desperately, relentlessly
entries.zh: 慢慢、轻轻、快速、敏捷；颤巍巍、小心；疯狂、盲目、无助、拼命、不停歇。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Body stiffened and she froze to the spot

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She sat corpse-like – frozen and motionless.
entries.zh: 她像尸体一样坐着，僵硬而一动不动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She moved as delicately as a wild creature stalking its prey.
entries.zh: 她动作轻巧，像潜行追踪猎物的野兽。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He padded noiselessly up the stairs in his bare feet.
entries.zh: 他光着脚，无声地走上楼梯。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He crabbed slowly along the ledge and felt the way with his feet.
entries.zh: 他沿凸沿慢慢横挪，用双脚探路。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was as if time had stopped. He stood perfectly still, frozen to the floor, paralysed by fear.
entries.zh: 时间仿佛停了。他一动不动地站着，像被冻在地上，恐惧使他无法动弹。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He lingered in the shadows, motionless – alert and ready to move quickly.
entries.zh: 他停在阴影里纹丝不动，警惕着，随时准备迅速行动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He slithered to a halt and stood with his hands on his hips, head bowed, gasping for breath.
entries.zh: 他滑行着停下，双手叉腰、低着头，大口喘气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He huddled in the darkness, listening for any sound that might guide him.
entries.zh: 他蜷在黑暗里，倾听任何可能为他指路的声音。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She curled herself into a ball, shivering violently, and covered her head with her hands.
entries.zh: 她蜷成一团，剧烈发抖，双手护住头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He crawled over the ground, keeping low, hardly daring to raise his head.
entries.zh: 他低伏着在地上爬，几乎不敢抬头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He moved slowly. Treading lightly, he checked the area around him, searching for any movement.
entries.zh: 他慢慢移动，轻轻落脚，查看四周，搜寻任何动静。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Flat on her belly, she slithered snake-like out of the room.
entries.zh: 她肚皮贴地，像蛇一样爬出了房间。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her steps quickened until her feet appeared to be flying.
entries.zh: 她越走越快，双脚仿佛飞了起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She scrambled up the bank, chest heaving and gasping for breath.
entries.zh: 她手脚并用爬上岸，胸口剧烈起伏，大口喘气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He ran like a scuttling lizard, with his legs flailing sideways and forwards.
entries.zh: 他像急窜的蜥蜴一样奔跑，两腿向侧面和前方乱甩。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert bent over and ran with his bottom in the air, scuttling like a rabbit in a warren.
entries.zh: 罗伯特弯腰翘着屁股奔跑，像兔子在洞穴里急窜。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She stumbled and flung her hand out in front of her – groping for something to stop her falling.
entries.zh: 她绊了一下，猛地向前伸手，想抓住什么以免摔倒。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They maintained a feverish pace and surged forward relentlessly.
entries.zh: 他们保持着急切的速度，不停向前冲。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He started to run, faster and faster, his head down, his arms pumping and his legs a blur of movement.
entries.zh: 他开始跑，越跑越快，低着头，双臂摆动，两腿快成一团模糊的影子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He darted and dodged through the trees. Blundering and slipping, he fought his way through the undergrowth.
entries.zh: 他在树间左冲右闪，跌撞打滑，奋力穿过低矮的灌木。
